 For the State : Mrs. Shweta Singh, A.P.P.
 ------
 I.A. No. 3364 of 2024
03/15.04.2024:
This interlocutory application has been filed by the appellan praying therein to suspend the sentence and release him on bail during the pendency of this appeal.

2. The appellant has been convicted and sentenced in connection with POCSO Case No. 26/2020,
arsing out of Jama P.S. Case No. 111/2020, for the offence under Section(s) 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life and fine of Rs. 25,000/-.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. After hearing the parties and going through the evidence of the victim (PW.1) and the medical evidence, we find that on the date of examination, the victim was found below 16 years.
There is live foetus of nineteen weeks and six days.
Further, the allegation is that there was sexual assault for last two years.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and the age of the victim at the time of occurrence, we are not inclined to accept the argument of the learned counsel for the appellant that the sexual intercourse Godo Rai @ Chhotu vs The State Of Jharkhand on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10444956/
1 was consensual in nature.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the appellant, named above, is rejected.
7. Accordingly, this interlocutory application is dismissed.
